title: AcademicPaperAnalysis
description: Structured extraction schema for the /analyze-paper skill covering Problem, Methods/Algorithms, Datasets, Metrics, Relational Results, and Critical Review.

venue.description: Conference, journal, or arXiv preprint identifier

source_url_or_path.description: Original file path, DOI, or arXiv URL

code_url.description: Official GitHub/code URL if mentioned, or 'Not provided'

tldr.description: 2-3 sentence executive summary of what the paper does and why it matters

compute_specified.description: Hardware/compute details (e.g., '8x NVIDIA A100 80GB') or 'Not specified'

broad_domain.description: e.g., Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Systems, Bioinformatics

specific_task.description: e.g., Long-Context Question Answering, Real-Time 3D Object Detection

problem_type_badges.description: Taxonomy tags for the problem (e.g., 'Efficiency Bottleneck', 'New Benchmark/Task', 'Generalization / OOD', 'Theoretical Analysis')

problem_statement.description: Clear formulation of the core research problem being solved

research_questions.description: Explicit or implicit research questions addressed by the paper

prior_bottlenecks.description: Why existing methods or baselines fail or struggle on this problem

key_contributions.description: Primary novel contributions claimed by the authors

primary_paradigm.description: e.g., Transformer / Attention, Diffusion Model, Graph Neural Network, Symbolic / Heuristic

method_summary.description: End-to-end overview of how the proposed approach works

name.description: Name of the algorithm, module, loss function, or technique

category.description: e.g., 'Core Architecture', 'Objective / Loss Function', 'Training Strategy', 'Inference Optimization'

is_novel.description: True if proposed by this paper; false if adopted as a backbone/component

role.description: What problem sub-task this component addresses

mechanism.description: Technical explanation of how it works (including key equations or algorithmic steps)

evidence_location.description: Section, equation, or figure reference (e.g., 'Section 3.2, Eq. 4, Fig. 2')

baselines_compared.description: Prior algorithms/models compared against in experiments

pipeline_steps.description: Sequential workflow stages of the proposed method for visual rendering

datasets.description: List of all datasets, benchmarks, or simulation environments used in the paper

name.description: Canonical name of the dataset or benchmark

usage_role.description: How the dataset is used in this paper

scale_and_splits.description: Sample counts, train/val/test split sizes, or resolution details

domain.description: Specific domain of the data (e.g., 'Medical Chest X-Rays', 'Python GitHub Issues')

preprocessing_or_notes.description: Any special filtering, sub-sampling, or preprocessing applied

metrics.description: List of all evaluation metrics and criteria used to measure performance

purpose.description: What specific aspect of model behavior this metric evaluates and how it is defined

is_primary.description: True if this is a headline evaluation metric of the paper

experimental_results.description: Relational mapping linking Method + Dataset + Metric + Quantitative Score + Comparison vs. Baseline

proposed_score.description: Score achieved by the proposed method (with units/std if reported)

best_baseline_name.description: Strongest prior baseline on this dataset/metric

best_baseline_score.description: Score of the strongest prior baseline

strengths.description: Key technical strengths, strong ablations, or practical impact

limitations.description: Author-acknowledged limitations and reviewer-identified blind spots or assumptions

future_directions.description: Open questions and next steps suggested by the paper
